title: benthamidia florida var. pendula
intro: Benthamidia florida var. pendula, commonly known as the Orange Jessamine or Night-Blooming Jasmine, is a flowering evergreen plant native to Hawaii. It is valued for its fragrant, white flowers that bloom at night and are often used in perfumes and fragrances. The health benefits of Benthamidia florida var. pendula include its potential to reduce anxiety and promote relaxation due to its sedative properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids and alkaloids, which may help to reduce inflammation and improve sleep quality.
